evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a repository and sets only user.email/user.name before committing, but does not disable inherited commit.gpgSign. If a developer has commit.gpgSign=true globally and no signing key matching fixture@example.invalid, git commit at line 94 fails and every DeployTests case errors in setUp(). Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is a small, compatible hermetic-test fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
